accepted.quote: At a time when working-class families are already struggling with rising grocery prices, the cost of housing, and the consequences of the disastrous economic policies of the Trump Administration, H.J. Res. 59 would make life even harder for the American people by giving big banks permission to increase costs for consumers with excessively high overdraft fees.
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes the resolution for enabling higher overdraft costs for consumers, indicating support for consumer protection.
